Lemma
[The Gram Determinant of a Frame is Nonzero]

↗ def:frame-matrix

For every $x\in u$, the Gram determinant $\det (g_{ij}(x))$ of a local frame is nonzero.

Proof

↗ def:frame-matrix \sketch The Gram matrix is nonsingular exactly when its vectors are linearly independent; frame values are a basis of $T_xM$.

□
